scope: Paired-camera observed vertical extent transfer for the Rible corrected archived levitated-drop silhouettes. Whole-movie conditional measurements, never prospective prediction of a future movie or unseen formulation.
exposure: Paper aggregate results, labels, camera specifications, number of frames and field names inspected. No released shape or full-signal values opened before this protocol. Debug acquisition ID, rate and frame count read only.
units: A single designated camera1 DW Green first replicate checks exported bbox height, width, major, minor, orientation and maximum vertical chord against original pixel cache at all common frame IDs. Only accept one common linear absolute unit factor per length field among pixel units, pixels/ruler-scale mm, or literal multiply-by-10 cache convention. Quantization check in both cameras on dev for integer spans. Apply the identified unit rule by camera, using the release camera-wide px/mm regardless of duplicate Properties labels. Refuse incompatible field scaling or row mapping. On matched corrected archive, alternatively compare multiplicative scale inferred from same field actual integers, never estimated on held camera2 observations.
endpoint: For each movie, camera2 empirical bbox_heigth quantiles at probabilities k/20 for k=1,...,19. Use order statistic index ceil(n p)-1 (inverse empirical CDF), all finite original frames. Any nonfinite, nonpositive lengths or nonsequential/missing frame IDs refuses course; no bad-frame filtering. Whole-movie RMS in mm across 19 equally weighted quantiles, macro arithmetic mean RMS across 24 independent held replicates within the apparatus. No independent-frame significance test.
roles: common_vertical_box: literal camera1 bbox height at each quantile (the primary).
projected_ellipse: per-frame sqrt((major*sin(angle))^2+(minor*cos(angle))^2) using regionprops orientation degrees before quantiles.
maximum_chord: per-frame author verticalAxis from maximal single-column chord, distinct from overall vertical extent.
uniform_time_mean: source camera1 mean bbox height repeated at every quantile.
condition_median: mean of the two development camera2 target quantile curves within the held fluid/nozzle.
affine_box: least squares one slope and intercept mapping source box quantiles to target quantiles, equal weight per dev movie/quantile.
multi_feature: linear dev OLS on intercept, source box, projected ellipse, chord, horizontal width and mean bbox; no regularization choice; fixed minimum-norm solve.
pass: Literal common-box mean RMS must beat each other nonidentical role and win strictly at least 13/24 movies against the pooled affine and multi-feature calibrators separately. Preserve full primary if it loses. All means/win counts also reported.
additional: For literal box compute unequal-length exact empirical W2 in mm by integrating squared quantile differences over both discrete CDF jump sets. It is a lower bound on the RMS of any equal-mass coupling of the two observed movie distributions. Report ordered common-prefix frame pairing separately as convention only, with no lag search. Whole-frame counts remain visible; where lengths differ, the prefix RMS is on another finite sample and is not compared algebraically to the whole-distribution W2. Diagnostic conservative conditional quantization allowance from half a source pixel per silhouette edge (one pixel per camera per height), plus sum of reported camera fractional ruler uncertainties times observed physical height as sensitivity only. No claim as a universal imaging bound. No uniqueness for 3D shapes or modes. Document repeated projected descriptors without equating repeated height alone to segment failure, and full-row immediate duplicates excluding frame index.
capability: All 72 pairs analyzed on released frame measures, original pixel masks only source/debug commissioning. One fixed scale per camera from 8 ruler readings. Any matching ambiguities exposed; no held data used to realign labels, derive filters or refit sensor gain. Training-only native contributor before target; all forecast arrays hashed as canonical little-endian float64 per role before held camera2 read. Worst held entry for every role and alternatives on primary worst. Archive sizes and exact labels preserved.
